definitions.explanation: A legal or financial obligation to pay money or perform a duty. A formal term used in legal, financial, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{債務|さいむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The company is burdened with a large amount of debt.

examples.japanese: {債務|さいむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}する→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{10年|じゅうねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took 10 years to repay the debt.

examples.japanese: {債務|さいむ}⟦{超過|ちょうか}→超過：04523_chouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}した→倒産：03452_tousan⟧。
examples.english: They went bankrupt due to excessive debt.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{債|さい} (debt, bond) + {務|む} (duty, obligation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {債務|さいむ} (debt - obligation to pay) ↔ ⟦{債権|さいけん}→債権：08870_saiken⟧ (credit - right to collect)
- ⟦{債務者|さいむしゃ}→債務者：22281_saimusha⟧ (debtor) ↔ ⟦{債権者|さいけんしゃ}→債権者：22802_saikensha⟧ (creditor)

REGISTER:
- {債務|さいむ} - formal/legal term
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧ - casual term for personal debt
- ⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧ - loanword for loans

COMMON COMPOUND TERMS:
- {債務|さいむ}⟦{超過|ちょうか}→超過：04523_chouka⟧ (insolvency - liabilities exceed assets)
- {債務|さいむ}⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ (debt consolidation/restructuring)
- {債務|さいむ}⟦{不履行|ふりこう}→不履行：30030_furikou⟧ (default on debt)
- ⟦{連帯|れんたい}→連帯：14425_rentai⟧{債務|さいむ} (joint and several liability)
- ⟦{多重|たじゅう}→多重：19772_tajuu⟧{債務|さいむ} (multiple debts - often problematic)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
{債務|さいむ} is the standard legal term in Japanese civil law for obligations that can be enforced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {債務|さいむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to incur debt)
- {債務|さいむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}する→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (to repay debt)
- {債務|さいむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ (debt swells/grows)
- {債務|さいむ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to run from debt)
